import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 505;
    static int n, m, mod;
    static int[][] c = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static T[] dp = new T[maxn];
    static T[][] pdp = new T[maxn][maxn];

    static class T {
        int cnt, sum;

        T() {
            this.cnt = 0;
            this.sum = 0;
        }

        T(int x) {
            this.cnt = x;
            this.sum = 0;
        }

        T(int c, int s) {
            this.cnt = c;
            this.sum = s;
        }

        T multiply(T t) {
            int s = prod(this.cnt, t.sum);
            s = update_value(s, prod(this.sum, t.cnt));
            return new T(prod(this.cnt, t.cnt), s);
        }

        T add(T t) {
            int c = this.cnt;
            c = update_value(c, t.cnt);
            int s = this.sum;
            s = update_value(s, t.sum);
            return new T(c, s);
        }
    }

    static int getRandom(int x) {
        Random rand = new Random();
        return rand.nextInt(x);
    }

    static int prod(int a, int b) {
        long res = (long) a * b;
        return (int) (res % mod);
    }

    static int update_value(int a, int b) {
        a += b;
        if (a >= mod) a -= mod;
        return a;
    }

    static boolean readData(Scanner sc) {
        if (sc.hasNextInt()) {
            n = sc.nextInt();
            if (sc.hasNextInt()) {
                m = sc.nextInt();
                if (sc.hasNextInt()) {
                    mod = sc.nextInt();
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void setup() {
        // No specific setup needed in Java
    }

    static void processData() {
        // Compute binomial coefficients
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; ++i) {
            c[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                c[i][j] = c[i - 1][j - 1];
                c[i][j] = update_value(c[i][j], c[i - 1][j]);
            }
        }

        // Initialize dp array
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; ++i) {
            dp[i] = new T(0);
        }
        dp[0] = new T(1);

        // Compute dp
        for (int k = 1; k <= m; ++k) {
            T cur = new T(0);
            for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
                T x = dp[i].multiply(dp[k - i - 1]);
                x = x.multiply(new T(c[k - 1][i]));
                for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
                    T y = x.multiply(new T(1 + (j == i ? 1 : 0), Math.abs(i - j)));
                    cur = cur.add(y);
                }
            }
            dp[k] = cur;
        }

        // Initialize pdp array
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
                pdp[i][j] = new T(0);
            }
        }
        pdp[0][0] = new T(1);

        // Dynamic programming over i and j
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
                T current = pdp[i][j];
                if (current.cnt == 0 && current.sum == 0) continue;

                // Transition to next i
                pdp[i + 1][j] = pdp[i + 1][j].add(current);

                // Transition with k steps
                for (int k = 1; j + k <= m && i + k <= n; ++k) {
                    T next = pdp[Math.min(n, i + k + 1)][j + k];
                    T val = current.multiply(dp[k]).multiply(new T(c[m - j][k]));
                    pdp[Math.min(n, i + k + 1)][j + k] = next.add(val);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(pdp[n][m].sum);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        setup();
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (readData(sc)) {
            processData();
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
